IntelMSR.p is additionally included separately for convenient review.

PC Insight does not bundle or install the PawnIO kernel driver or PawnIOLib.
It communicates with the user's already installed driver using the documented
device IO control interface. Upstream recommends obtaining the official driver
from https://pawnio.eu. The official driver binary has separate distribution
terms; the module's LGPL notice does not grant a license to those driver binaries.

Interface references:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/wiki/Using-PawnIO-Modules
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO/blob/master/PawnIO/include/pawnio_um.h
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/blob/0.2.11/IntelMSR.p

The PC Insight client loads only the pinned official signed module and exposes
only reads of MSR 0x606/0x610 and writes of the two wattage fields in MSR 0x610.
It does not expose the module's other register controls. Modifying this client
or its module requires rebuilding/reviewing the corresponding source; arbitrary
module replacement is deliberately rejected by the distributed application.
No BIOS locks, Windows security settings or driver signature checks are changed.

This component is supplied without warranty; see COPYING.LESSER for the full
license and warranty disclaimer.
